model.name: PtyBridge.attachPane
model.description: On owner-verified ticket at ws upgrade: node-pty spawns a tmux client on a grouped session (tmux new-session -t <target> + select-pane) attached READ-ONLY (-r); stream PTY bytes as binary ws frames to xterm; prime pre-attach history via one-shot capture-pane -S -N; xterm onResize -> pty.resize (native, grouped=no clobber). Take-Control respawns read-write + forwards keys (audit CONTROL_TAKEN). Detach kills pty + grouped session (no orphan). NOT pipe-pane+send-keys. R31.4. Design-ahead, no impl yet.
